projects.title: PiDerm - Low cost skin disease detection
projects.description: PiDerm is an ultra low cost Deep Learning based Skin disease detection product that can be generalized to any model ensemble. The Raspberry Pi and web interface allow for easy viewing of patient data and also model statistics at very low latencies.

projects.title: PetMonitor
projects.description: Pet Monitoring system for cats and dogs

projects.title: Laser-Guided Insect Detection and Tracking Using Raspberry Pi
projects.description: This project combines computer vision and robotics to detect and track insects using a Raspberry Pi camera and laser module. Classic vision techniques to detected insects and laser, while proportional control mechanisms guide the robot's head and movements for precise tracking.

projects.title: WiFi Sensing for Fall Detection
projects.description: Did you know that WiFi chips can sense their surroundings in a sonar-like fashion? This project uses the built in WiFi chip on an inexpensive Raspberry Pi to detect when a person nearby falls down, to e.g. help the elderly - like Life Alert, but automatic and wearable-free!

projects.title: Intelligent Pet Monitor System
projects.description: An intelligent pet monitor system that tracks your pet's location and activities in real time, delivering instant updates and notifications straight to your mobile device.

projects.title: Cama-l Pack Moisture Monitoring Solutions
projects.description: The Cama team developed several plant moisture monitoring solutions using Raspberry Pi and Arduino. We created several different dashboards including web hosted options and a custom cell phone application that connects to the Pi through Bluetooth.

projects.title: Medication Reminder IOT Pill Cap
projects.description: Medication reminder bottle cap that is easy to see, easy to understand, which allows 3rd party monitoring, and which can be customized to different medication frequency regimens.

projects.title: Poker Pro
projects.description: PokerPro is a real-time poker odds calculator that uses computer vision to detect cards and a Monte Carlo simulation to calculate winning probabilities. The system provides audio feedback to the player through headphones, helping both novice and experienced players make better decisions.

projects.title: Smart Security System
projects.description: Security system utilizing computer vision for person detection.

projects.title: Smart Fridge IoT System
projects.description: The Smart Fridge IoT system optimizes food management within households through real-time tracking of ingredients, expiration dates, and storage conditions. It also recommends recipes through machine learning to encourage households to use up ingredients.

projects.title: Smart Breathalyzer
projects.description: The Smart Breathalyzer provides a fun and intuitive way of measuring BAC, promoting safe and smart alcohol consumption. The pocketable device connects to the IoT world using Home Assistant, allowing for data storage and a complex IoT interactions.

projects.title: DoorWAI
projects.description: DoorWAI is an intelligent doorbell system that combines real-time video monitoring, two-way communication, and AI-powered visitor detection.

projects.title: cAIms: Facial Recognition Alarm System
projects.description: A Camera Monitoring System with AI in the Middle

projects.title: LibraryWaze
projects.description: We present LibraryWaze, a Library occupancy monitoring IoT solution designed to help students efficiently plan their study sessions and library visits by providing real-time information and updates on available study spaces.

projects.title: MoodLight Manager
projects.description: This eco-friendly LED lighting system enhances room aesthetics while functioning as a visual calendar. A motion sensor ensures lights activate only when people are present, conserving energy. By syncing with Google Calendar, it displays dynamic light patterns for events, deadlines, and reminders.

projects.title: Automated Parking with Camera
projects.description: Our final project is an automated parking system for the Pycar. Drivers across America are very interested in automated parking due to the challenges they face in parking. We wanted to explore this problem with our pycar to see if we could generate any interesting solutions.

projects.title: Automated Checkout System for Corporate Cafeterias
projects.description: Cafeteria checkout inefficiencies, exacerbated by post-COVID employee presence, can be addressed with AI and IoT innovations. These innovations streamline operations, reduce wait times, and improve employee satisfaction and productivity.

projects.title: Reliability Optimization and Observability System (ROOS)
projects.description: This project enabled request mapping, automated alerts via Azure-Jira, and SLO data storage, improving observability and reliability for Medline's E-Commerce platform.

projects.title: NFT Polaroid
projects.description: Automatically mint every picture taken by the raspberry pi as NFT in the TON network

projects.title: Smart Doorbell
projects.description: Our AI-powered smart doorbell features speech recognition, facial detection, and context-aware responses using Llama API, providing dynamic guest interactions. It supports real-time video streaming. Compact and responsive, it prioritizes security, user convenience, and seamless connectivity.

projects.title: Smart Pantry System
projects.description: Ever come home to find out your missing a key ingredient for dinner? Or do you waste food because you buy more of the same produce and it goes bad too quickly? The Smart Pantry give you up to date info about your pantry, so you don't have to second guess.
